testimonials.review: I could not walk 50 steps without excruciating knee pain for 4 years. Dr. Sharma performed robotic bilateral knee replacement. On Day 2, I walked to the bathroom myself without a walker. Truly a miracle.
Suffered a complete ACL tear during badminton practice. The endoscopic repair was so clean that within 6 weeks I was back to jogging. The hospital staff and transparent billing were unmatched.
Traveled from Muzaffarpur for chronic sciatica. Discharged the same evening after micro-endoscopic decompression. No back pain since. Highly recommend Sharma Clinic.

faqs.question: How long after robotic knee surgery can I walk?
faqs.answer: Over 95% of our patients take their first supported steps within 12 to 24 hours of surgery. With robotic 3D navigation, quadricep muscles are spared, allowing rapid mobilization and home discharge in 48 hours.

faqs.question: Is cashless medical insurance accepted?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer 100% cashless hospitalization across all major TPAs, Star Health, HDFC ERGO, ICICI Lombard, Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY, and corporate panels with 45-minute desk pre-authorization.

faqs.question: What is the difference between conventional and robotic surgery?
faqs.answer: Conventional surgery relies on manual mechanical cutting blocks with a 3mm margin of error. Our robotic arm creates an exact 3D virtual bone map, cutting with 0.2mm precision and extending implant lifespan past 30 years.
